dossier_meta.paper: Induced subgraphs of graphs with large chromatic number. IV. Consecutiv…
dossier_meta.statement_text: Statement 2.1 might be true when $\ell = 4$: let $\varphi : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be a non-decreasing function; does there exist $n$ such that every $(2,\varphi)$-controlled triangle-free graph with chromatic number more than $n$ has a $4$-hole?
dossier_meta.context_text: Statement 2.1 is proved in the paper for all $\ell \geq 5$ (with $\ell = 7$ handled by a prior paper). The authors remark that 2.1 might also hold for $\ell = 4$ but that they have not been able to decide this.
